resolution: Preserve both capabilities and select exactly one permission contract from the execution identity: developer-self-check may modify and fix; independent-qa is report-only and may not modify.
rationale: The source units describe different execution identities and permissions, not mutually exclusive product responsibilities. Binding the mode before inspection preserves repairable developer feedback and independent report-only QA without allowing one mode to inherit the other mode's write authority.
potential_loss: The same defect may be observed once by self-check and again by independent QA, and report-only QA cannot repair a finding in place.
verification_method: Run one developer-self-check case and one independent-black-box-QA case; confirm the former can produce a correction while the latter produces evidence without source edits.
next_design_case: Preserve explicit execution modes when a future combined workflow requests both repair and independent verification.
